about: Each arm's version history for the scorecard (scripts/dk_arms.py; dk_eval.py scorecard). A version holds from its date (versions.csv's date: the slate date it takes effect) on every slate, or, with first_slate, from that draft group on its first day (DraftKings numbers a day's draft groups in start order). rows: the versions.csv rows it carries (date | component | the change's first 40 characters; tests/dk_scorecard.py checks each exists). A new live change to an arm adds a version here beside its versions.csv row (analysis/cbb/dk/process.md).
